display.purpose: The single lead number on a reporting shelf. Mono, tabular, 54px.

headline.purpose: The page h1 and the sidebar clock. One per screen.

body.purpose: Nav rows, buttons, inputs, running copy. Measure caps at 52-64ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, nav section headers, stamps, counts, timestamps.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and popovers, which already carry a hairline edge. Token --shadow-menu.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: A clickable card under the cursor, paired with translateY(-1px).

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The card detail drawer sliding in from the right.

shadows.name: sidebar-mobile
shadows.purpose: The off-canvas sidebar over the page below 900px.

shadows.name: rail-flyout
shadows.purpose: Dark flyout panel over light content; no border needed.

shadows.name: seg-active
shadows.purpose: The white active pill inside a segmented control.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Field focus, paired with a Signal Red border.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Modal and drawer enter/leave. Settles, never pops.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Disclosures, chevrons, flyouts, hover states across screens.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Overlay entrance; opening earns a beat of anticipation.

motion.name: duration-leave
motion.purpose: Overlay exit; closing gets out of the way.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Default control transition (background, border, colour, shadow).

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Tap feedback on buttons, pills and segmented controls.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Per-item delay for a list rising into place (calc(var(--i) * 42ms)).

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entrance, translateY(10px) + scale(.98) to rest.

motion.name: slide
motion.purpose: .uj-slide — a panel entering from the right (translateX(24px) + fade).

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: .uj-fade — everything else, and the reduced-motion fallback for .uj-slide.

motion.name: nav-busy
motion.purpose: Partial navigation dims only the screen body while the next screen is fetched; the 90ms delay stops a fast swap flickering.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one red action on a screen. Height and padding are set at the call site.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; background: #d6232b; color: #fff; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b01b22; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d6232b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. White paper, hairline edge, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e5e0; color: #26251e; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #8b887e; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d6232b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: The default content surface: white, hairline, 12px radius, flat at rest.

components.name: Shelf
components.description: The heavier paper reserved for the one live task or lead figure on a screen. One per screen.
components.html:
This week
92%of scheduled hours logged across the team.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 44px field, red border plus tint glow on focus.

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: A stamped word, not a colour alone. data-tone switches the pair of tint and text-safe ink.
components.html: ACTION NEEDED APPROVED ARCHIVED
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .05em; white-space: nowrap; background: #efeee8; color: #6f6c61; } .ds-stamp[data-tone="red"] { background: #fcebec; color: #b01b22; } .ds-stamp[data-tone="amber"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, #c08532 13%, #fff); color: #7a5210; } .ds-stamp[data-tone="success"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, #1f8a65 13%, #fff); color: #14614a; } .ds-stamp[data-tone="error"] { background: #fcebec; color: #cf2d56; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Neutral track, white active pill. Red is the colour of the primary action, not of which tab you are on.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-right transient message with a tone disc and a draining progress bar that pauses on hover.
components.html: Leave request submitted for verification.
components.css: .ds-toast { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 11px; min-width: 258px; max-width: 400px; padding: 12px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e5e0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(38,37,30,.15), 0 2px 6px rgba(38,37,30,.06); overflow: hidden; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toast-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-top: 1px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: color-mix(in srgb, #1f8a65 14%, #fff); color: #1f8a65; } .ds-toast-icon svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; } .ds-toast-msg { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-top: 1px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #26251e; } .ds-toast-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 2px; transform-origin: left; opacity: .45; background: #1f8a65; animation: ds-toast-bar 5s linear forwards; } .ds-toast:hover .ds-toast-bar { animation-play-state: paused; } @keyframes ds-toast-bar { from { transform: scaleX(1); } to { transform: scaleX(0); } }

components.name: Disclosure Row

components.css: .ds-dq { border-bottom: 1px solid #efeee8; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dq-hd { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 13px 18px; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s ease-out; } .ds-dq-hd:hover { background: #f6f6f3; } .ds-dq-hd:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d6232b; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-dq-date { width: 42px; flex-shrink: 0; text-align: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #26251e; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-dq-date i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; color: #8b887e; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-dq-txt { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-dq-t { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #26251e; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-dq-s { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; color: #6f6c61; margin-top: 2px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-dq-chev { flex-shrink: 0; color: #8b887e; transition: transform .2s ease-out; } .ds-dq-hd[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-dq-chev { transform: rotate(90deg); }

narrative.overview:
Amanahku is a record of work, kept on paper. The page is a warm off-white sheet (#f6f6f3), never pure white and never grey-blue. Text is ink, not black. Edges are drawn with a 1px hairline the way a ruled ledger draws them, not with a shadow. Every number, timestamp, percentage and duration is set in mono with tabular figures, so a column of them stacks like a hand-kept account book instead of dancing as the digits change.

One red (#d6232b) carries the whole voice of the system. It marks the primary action, the focus ring, the active nav icon, and nothing else. Tabs, selected segments and current filters use a white pill on a neutral track, not red, because red answers the question "what do I do here" and never "where am I". This restraint is what makes a screen with twenty rows of leave requests still tell you in one glance where the one button is.

The interface is dense but not cramped. Type runs small (14px body, 11px labels) because these screens hold a working day's worth of rows; the compensation is generous line-height, a hard 920px reading measure, and whitespace between sections rather than inside them. The dark sidebar (#211f1b) is the one heavy element on the page: it holds navigation and the clock, so the paper stays undisturbed for content. Nothing decorates. Every visual weight in the system is either a status, a hierarchy, or an action.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas, ink text, never a cold grey
One red, used rarely and only for action and focus
Hairlines draw edges; shadows only mean distance
Mono, tabular figures for every number
Five type sizes, one role each, no sizes in between
Two materials: --card white for content, --shelf for the one live task
Status is a stamped word, never a colour alone

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Red means "act" or "you are focused here". It never marks the current tab, the selected segment, or a decorative accent. If two red things are visible on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Tone Rule
rules.body: A semantic colour used as a fill and the same colour used as text are two different tokens. Use --success-ink (and the paired dark tones inside stamps) whenever the colour carries words.

rules.name: The Tint-By-Mix Rule
rules.body: Tone backgrounds are mixed at 7-14% of the tone into white with color-mix(), never hand-picked. A new tone gets its surface for free and stays in family.

rules.name: The Five Steps Rule
rules.body: Do not add a size between the ramp steps. If something needs to sit between 14px and 16px, it needs a different weight or colour, not a sixth size.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Any digit that can change on screen (clock, percentage, count, duration) is mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Numbers must not shift their neighbours when they update.

rules.name: The Inherit Rule
rules.body: button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit } is load-bearing. A bare control otherwise drops to 13.33px Arial and falls off the ramp entirely.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: A screen never stretches edge to edge and never pins left. Header and body share the same measure, so screens read consistently as you move between them.

rules.name: The Fold, Don't Drop Rule
rules.body: When the header narrows, controls relocate into the More menu. Only the desktop-oriented people-search is genuinely removed, and only on phones.

rules.name: The Border-Then-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If an element has a hairline, its shadow may only lift it. A wide soft blur under a bordered element reads as a generic halo, not elevation.

rules.name: The Distance Rule
rules.body: Shadow size tracks real distance: 5px blur for a menu, 34-44px for a drawer or toast. Never the reverse.

rules.name: The Radius-With-Size Rule
rules.body: Small controls take 7-9px, cards take 12px, shelves take 14px. Do not put a 14px radius on a 32px control or a 6px radius on a full-width panel.

dos: Do use Signal Red only for the primary action, the focus ring, and the active nav icon.
Do set every changeable number in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do stay on the five type steps (11 / 12.5 / 14 / 16 / 22) and change weight or colour instead of inventing a size.
Do draw edges with a 1px hairline token and let tone (canvas to shelf to card) carry depth.
Do stamp a word next to a status colour, so the state survives colour blindness and greyscale printing.
Do use --success-ink and the paired dark tone foregrounds whenever a semantic colour carries text.
Do mix tone surfaces with color-mix() at 7-14% into white.
Do keep every screen inside the shared measure (920px, or 1280px for data-dense screens).
Do pair every animation with a prefers-reduced-motion branch.
Do put row layout in a class, not an inline style, on any element x-show controls: Alpine wipes the inline display on reveal.
Do swap only the affected region for an in-screen action (resources/js/partial-nav.js), let pushState keep the URL honest, and fetch the Blade partial the server already renders.
Do keep the global :focus-visible ring, use .uj-sr-only for screen-reader-only text, and give every icon-only control an aria-label.
donts: Don't use red for tabs, selected segments, or decorative accents.
Don't put a shadow on a resting surface, or a wide soft blur under an element that already has a border.
Don't introduce pure white (#fff) as a page background or pure black as text; the canvas is warm paper and the text is ink.
Don't use a cold grey. Every neutral in this system carries a warm bias.
Don't animate width, height, top or left; use transforms and grid-template-rows.
Don't add a sixth type size or a radius outside the 5 / 7 / 9-10 / 12 / 14 / 999 scale.
Don't make the header a container query context's victim: keep fixed-position modals out of any element that sets container-type.
Don't rely on colour alone for a status; if there is no room for a stamp, use a tone chip with a border.
Don't reload the whole page for an in-screen action, and don't duplicate server-rendered markup inside Alpine to avoid it.
